subject: gk
question: Which of the following companies won the CII-ITC Sustainability Award 2020 in the ‘Corporate Excellence’ category in the Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) domain?

options.text: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited (ONGC)
Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWER GRID)

solution:
The correct answer is __**National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC)**__**.**

__
 
• The country’s largest power producer, **National Thermal Power Corporation Limited (NTPC)** has been conferred “Excellence” in the prestigious **CII-ITC** **Sustainability Awards 2020** in Corporate Social Responsibility **(CSR) Domain.**
 
• NTPC has been honored in the Corporate Excellence Category, Commendation for Significant Achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• This is the highest award conferred by CII-ITC in the CSR domain.
 
• NTPC is the only PSU to receive the award in the Corporate Excellence category.
 
• NTPC wins the prestigious CII-ITC Sustainability Awards in Corporate Excellence category second time in a row in the years 2019 and 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
